1-Family And 2-Family Treatment Note (Page 26 Of Barre City Unified Development Ordinance):

Existing Single- And Two-Family Dwellings And Adus Will Be Considered A Permitted Use, But Construction Of New Single- Or Two-Family Dwellings Is Prohibited. Uses Associated With Existing Single- Or Two-Family Dwellings Such As Accessory Dwellings, Home Occupations, Group Homes And Bed-And-Breakfasts Will Be Allowed to The Same Extent As Allowed Within Single- And Two-Family Dwellings In Other Districts.
